entrypoint: Offline speech-to-text for any audio or video file (m4a, mp3, wav, mp4…) with faster-whisper's multilingual base model, downloaded during install
install_command:
pip install "faster-whisper==1.2.1" "av==15.1.0" "huggingface_hub>=0.23,<3"
python - <<'PY'
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
snapshot_download(repo_id="Systran/faster-whisper-base", local_dir="./models/faster-whisper-base")
PY
